added: A list can have bags — checked, carry-on, personal item or worn — and each row says which bag it travels in, with a quantity split between bags when you want one.

A By bag view beside By category groups the list by bag, shows each bag's weight with its own empty weight against the limit you set, and turns red when it's over; packing mode ticks each bag's share off separately.
The connector can set up bags and put rows into them (set_bags, pack_items), and get_list reports each bag's weight.
